messages:
alex (AE): Quick sync — ACME POC scope & runway. They want a 6-week trial to validate support automation + draft generation + reranking. Need to lock success criteria, SE hours, pricing, and answers to their security questionnaire. Can we do a quick alignment? @sam @devon @jordan

sam (SE): I can do 15m at 10am. Quick notes: core deliverables: integration adapter for support ticket export, prompt set + eval harness, baseline run on hosted vs dedicated. Metrics: latency p95 < 250ms, end-user satisfaction >= 85% (human eval), generation F1 on NER extraction >= 0.70, rerank MRR uplift >= 12%. We'll need access to sample tickets, logs, and a golden prompt set.

devon (Solutions): Proposed timeline: Week0 kickoff + SOW, Week1 prompt design & eval set, Week2 sandbox integration (webhook + export), Week3 run 10k eval tokens + tuning, Week4 canary with 1k live users, Week5 finalize handoff + docs, Week6 project wrap & ROI review. SE resourcing: 0.5 FTE for 3 weeks + 8h/week on-call support after going live.

jordan (CISO): Security Qs from legal: data-at-rest encryption, KMS integration, audit logs availability, data retention controls, ability to run in VPC/private deployment, SOC2 scope, breach notification SLA. Also need to confirm we can disable telemetry and ensure PII redaction options during POC. Please flag anything we can't meet.

sam (SE): Infra notes: For deterministic latency we should use Dedicated (reserved) GPUs for the POC; fallback to Hosted will affect p95. Recommend per-customer prefix KV cache + batching window tuned to their traffic pattern. Quantization plan: int8 for cost saving, A/B vs fp16 for quality. For evals we'll do automated metrics + ~100 human labels for the final quality gate. Also will surface token cost estimates with each config.

alex (AE): Pricing check — what's a ballpark for 6-week POC including SE support, Dedicated capacity, and eval credits? Customer wants an order-of-magnitude to prep procurement.

sam (SE): Ballpark: SE consulting time ~40 hours -> estimate $10-15k (internal rate); infra/dedicated reservation for 6 weeks ~ $8-12k depending on GPU SKU; eval credits + labeling budget ~$2-4k. Rough total $20-30k. We can offer promotional credits or reduce SE bill if needed — I’ll confirm exacts with finance.

devon (Solutions): For acceptance criteria, propose minimal pass: latency p95 <= 300ms on Dedicated, generation quality >= 80% pass rate on blind human eval for top 3 intents, rerank ROI >= 10% CTR/CRM lift. If they fail, we provide 2 tuning cycles + a remediation plan.

jordan (CISO): Also need a named contact for the security questionnaire — route to solutions-security@redwood.com. We'll want sample network diagrams and a redacted logs screenshot. If they require DPA, mark as high priority.

alex (AE): Action items: 1) sam to produce itemized POC SOW + SE hours estimate by EOD. 2) devon to draft 6-week plan + milestone owners by tomorrow. 3) jordan to send security checklist answers and required artifacts. 4) I’ll surface pricing band and negotiate credits. If everyone OK I’ll send to ACME later today.

ops-bot: deploybot: scheduled deployment to dedicated-pool-1 tomorrow 02:00 UTC (informational).

sam (SE): ACK. I'll include required test prompts and a minimal eval harness. Example prompt set (seed):
```
Prompt: "Summarize customer issue and propose triage steps"
Inputs: 2000 historical tickets
Eval: human-score 1-5 for accuracy & helpfulness
Metric: % >=4 >= 85%
```
Also adding a small logs pull example: `curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/logs?since=2026-03-01T00:00:00Z`

devon (Solutions): :thumbsup: Sounds good. If no blockers I'll draft the SOW and send to #contracts for review.
